note: Year-level evidence file created because the legacy master events.json is too large for reliable connector reads. Only sourced/canonical or deliberately contextual rows belong here.

events.title: Tesla discloses $1.5 billion Bitcoin purchase
events.summary: Tesla disclosed that after changing its investment policy in January 2021 it had invested an aggregate $1.5 billion in Bitcoin.
events.significance: The purchase was the largest high-profile corporate Bitcoin allocation after MicroStrategy and pushed the corporate-treasury thesis into the global mainstream.

events.title: Axie Infinity launches Ronin mainnet
events.summary: Axie Infinity launched Ronin mainnet in February 2021 and began migrating its assets away from Ethereum.
events.significance: Ronin removed a major fee/scaling bottleneck and helped Axie's player economy grow dramatically later in 2021.

events.title: Beeple NFT sells for $69.3 million at Christie's
events.summary: Christie's sold Beeple's EVERYDAYS: THE FIRST 5000 DAYS for $69,346,250.
events.significance: The sale was a watershed moment that pushed NFTs and purely digital art into the global mainstream art market.

events.title: Coinbase goes public on Nasdaq
events.summary: Coinbase's Class A common stock began trading on Nasdaq under ticker COIN through a direct listing.
events.significance: A major crypto-native exchange entering US public markets became one of the clearest institutional milestones of the bull market.

events.title: Bored Ape Yacht Club launches
events.summary: BAYC launched with a one-week presale on 23 April 2021 at 0.08 ETH per ape; after a slow start the remaining collection sold out on 1 May.
events.significance: BAYC became the defining membership/PFP NFT brand of the 2021 NFT boom and helped reshape NFTs around identity, community and commercial IP.

sources.title: Yuga Labs — Let's Make A NFT

events.title: Axie Infinity's play-to-earn economy accelerates
events.summary: By May 2021 Axie reported 65,000 daily active users, rapidly rising marketplace activity and strong growth following its move to Ronin.
events.significance: Axie became the flagship of the play-to-earn model and a major example of crypto gaming creating real player income and asset ownership.

events.title: El Salvador passes the Bitcoin Law
events.summary: El Salvador's Legislative Assembly approved Decree No. 57, the Bitcoin Law, on 8 June 2021.
events.significance: El Salvador became the first country to legislate Bitcoin as legal tender, a historic sovereign-adoption milestone.

sources.title: El Salvador Legislative Assembly — 2021 Decrees, No. 57 Bitcoin Law

events.title: Ethereum London upgrade activates EIP-1559
events.summary: Ethereum activated the London upgrade at block 12,965,000, introducing EIP-1559 and a base-fee burn mechanism.
events.significance: EIP-1559 fundamentally redesigned Ethereum's fee market and introduced ETH burning, reshaping the asset's monetary economics.

events.title: Poly Network suffers a roughly $610 million cross-chain exploit
events.summary: An attacker exploited Poly Network and stole roughly $610 million across multiple chains, then later returned most of the assets.
events.significance: The episode was the largest DeFi theft to that point and became extraordinary because of the attacker's on-chain communications and return of funds.

events.title: El Salvador Bitcoin Law takes effect
events.summary: El Salvador's Bitcoin Law took effect on 7 September 2021, alongside the government's Chivo wallet rollout.
events.significance: This was the implementation phase of the world's first national Bitcoin legal-tender experiment.

sources.title: El Salvador Presidency — Bitcoin law effective from 7 September

events.title: China formalizes nationwide crackdown on crypto mining
events.summary: China's National Development and Reform Commission and other agencies formalized measures prohibiting new crypto-mining projects and accelerating the orderly closure of existing operations.
events.significance: The crackdown forced a historic geographic redistribution of Bitcoin mining and demonstrated that a national policy shock could rapidly reshape network infrastructure.

sources.title: China NDRC — Notice on rectifying virtual-currency mining activities

events.title: China declares virtual-currency business activities illegal financial activity
events.summary: The People's Bank of China and nine other authorities stated that virtual-currency exchange, brokerage, token financing and related services constituted illegal financial activity and also targeted offshore exchanges serving mainland residents.
events.significance: The notice was the strongest national-level trading restriction in China's long sequence of crypto crackdowns.

sources.title: People's Bank of China — Notice on virtual-currency trading risks

events.title: Bitcoin Taproot activates
events.summary: Bitcoin's Taproot soft fork activated at block 709,632 in November 2021, enabling Schnorr-signature and script-privacy improvements.
events.significance: Taproot was Bitcoin's most significant consensus upgrade since SegWit and later enabled new wallet, multisignature and inscription-related possibilities.

sources.title: Bitcoin Optech — Taproot activated at block 709,632

events.title: Bitcoin reaches its 2021 cycle all-time high near $69,000
events.summary: Bitcoin reached a record near $69,000 in November 2021; exact peak figures vary by venue and index.
events.significance: The peak capped the 2020–2021 bull market before the 2022 deleveraging and collapse cycle.
